newsitem.title: POLAND: Stomil announces PLN 13.6 mln tyre recall.
newsitem.headline: Stomil announces PLN 13.6 mln tyre recall.

text.p: Polish tyre maker Stomil Olsztyn SA said on Tuesday it was recalling two defective types of passenger car tyres and one type of delivery van tyre and that the operation could cost up to 13.6 million zlotys.

"Stomil Olsztyn, concerned with safety and the satisfaction of our customers, decided to replace free of charge two series of tyres for cars and one for delivery vehicles," Stomil, 52.1- percent owned by Michelin, said in a statement.
"The decision was prompted by the possibility of the severing of fragments of tyre tread in extreme circumstances such as high temperature, overload or low pressure," it said.
